description: Capability for the main window. `value-free` is every app command that hands the window no secret's value, generated by `build.rs` from the one list in `src/ipc_commands.rs` (ADR 0052). A vault's reveal and copy are granted by `vault-values.json`, not here, so a window added to this capability does not inherit them. `core:window:allow-start-dragging` is NOT in `core:default` and has to be named: Tauri's `data-tauri-drag-region` handler invokes `plugin:window|start_dragging` over the IPC, so without it charter's title bar is a bar the operator cannot grab. `internal_toggle_maximize` — the double-click — is already in the default set.
